titles.title: Honoring the unbreakable spirit, bravery, and legacy of women veterans and supporting recognition of "Women Veterans Recognition Day".
Honoring the unbreakable spirit, bravery, and legacy of women veterans and supporting recognition of "Women Veterans Recognition Day".

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Veterans' Affairs.

bill.summary: This resolution expresses support for the designation of Women Veterans Recognition Day and recognizes the contributions, sacrifices, and achievements of women veterans.
